qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 49a8838 and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit af84dc1 found no remaining defect. Correctness raised no finding. Its two optional items were adopted. とにかく's set-aside example now reads «Если оставить цену в стороне, качество хорошее»; this also resolves comprehensibility C1, which found that «Не говоря уже о цене» is commonly read additively, against the card's own note that Nはとにかく names what is set aside (JMdict 1443990 sense 2). ちゃんと's note now says that the translation «идеально, безупречно» «может преувеличивать: говорящий не обязательно утверждает…», closer to EN's "can therefore overstate … need not mean". Consistency raised no finding and recommended one guard: どんなに «как сильно; как бы ни» and どう «как; каким образом» share «как», and the card contrasts them, so どんなに now also excludes どう. Comprehensibility raised five findings. C2: たっぷり's «побольше воды» meant "a little more water" and «уйма времени» was a colloquial overstatement; both examples now use «вдоволь», matching the title and EN "plenty" (JMdict 1007240 sense 1; Kuznetsov побольше and уйма; Gramota вдоволь). C3 held that «соответственно» lacks a "respectively" sense. The title «каждый (из нескольких); соответственно» is kept: English Wiktionary lists that sense (соответственно sense 3, uncited; Kuznetsov and Russian Wiktionary do not list it separately), and the title mirrors EN "each; respectively" (JMdict 1596690). The reviewer's underlying concern held for the example, where a mid-sentence «соответственно» could read as "accordingly"; the example now ends the enumeration with it («живут в Токио и Осаке соответственно»). C4 asked to retitle たまらない «невыносимый; неотразимый». It was withdrawn: the title mirrors EN "unbearable; irresistible" and JMdict 1211340 senses 1-2, Kuznetsov's «неотразимый» sense 2 is the pleasurable sense taught on the card, and the "cannot contain oneself" use is taught separately with the て-form. C5 asked to delete せい's «Категория канго следует этому разбору…». It was withdrawn: the sentence renders EN's explanation of the card's kango tag and follows a sentence explaining the tentative Sino-Japanese derivation しょい (Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten on Kotobank). At recheck the comprehensibility reviewer withdrew C4 and C5 and judged C3 partially resolved, with no actionable defect remaining; it also withdrew its alternative title «каждому своё», an idiom with a different meaning. One further comprehensibility optional item was adopted: たった's «можно дойти» became «можно добраться», since 着きます does not specify walking. All three reviewers read all 30 cards in full against EN. Russian evidence includes Gramota and Kuznetsov entries (вволю, вдоволь, исправный, прелестный, уйма, неотразимый, совсем, ничего, как, выйти, вот, соответственно, побольше), Ozhegov and Russian Wiktionary (причём, всего-навсего, незадача, в связи с). The rechecks found no regression. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 53 EN exclusions across 18 lists are retained. Two of them lie inside the batch: しかも–それでも and たった–ただ. Thirty-seven direct, one-sided exclusions on 22 new cards (nine of them new lists: すみません, せい, そのまま, できれば, とにかく, とんでもない, どうしても, どこか and なにも) cover reviewed RU title overlaps and sense neighbours. Required (22), as the consistency reviewer classified them: どうしても–なかなか and 絶対, とんでもない–いえ, とにかく–何とか, そのまま–まま, すみません–申し訳, どうも and 謝る, しゃべる–ぺらぺら, べらべら and おしゃべり, しかも–更に, すてき–見事 and かわいい, ずっと–年中, せい–悪い, ただ–だけ and ばかり, たった–だけ, できれば–なるべく, and どこか–どこ and 辺り. Conservative (15): さて–ところで, しきりに–しばしば, せい–原因, それでも–しかし and でも, それと–それから, ただ–サービス, たっぷり–十分, たまたま–たまに, とんでもない–ひどい and 凄い, どうしても–ぜひ and 必ず, なにも–別に and, added in the fix, どんなに–どう. The author had classed thirteen of the reviewer's required entries as conservative and left たった–だけ unmarked; the records preserve both classifications. The candidate declared the first 36. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 16 relative links across the 15 listed Markdown word files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href forms: ばったり to たまたま, ぶかぶか to ぴったり, やがて and 何時か to そのうち, サービス, 単なる (first occurrence only), 唯一 and 無料 to ただ, 単に to ただ and たった, 実は to ところで (first occurrence; the reading is kept), 申し訳 to すみません, 秘密 to しゃべる, 豊富 to たっぷり, and, held from Batch 62, きちんと to ちゃんと and ところが to ところで. No surrounding prose was changed. Unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 63 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 16 of the 72-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (computed after Batch 207 from 2,157 remaining EN words; 1,677 remained after Batch 223). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing was added. Two source exclusion entries lie inside the batch (しかも–それでも and たった–ただ); the other 51 EN exclusion entries target existing RU cards.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped (2 EN link occurrences, 2 targets) in the new cards: すみません→ごめんなさい and すみません→ありがとう. All 30 new cards are written in kana and link no kanji card, so no kanji label is left plain. Links otherwise follow EN, with nine RU-only links to existing cards at a comparison, a component or a source-verb sentence: どんなに→どう, できれば→可能 and 必ず, それと→それとも, それでも→まだ, そのまま→まま, すみません→済む, しゃべる→黙る and しまった→しまう.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: a parenthetical for ちゃんと's «исправно» (comprehensibility; it would change the title, JMdict 1007720 sense 2 includes "in good condition; regularly; properly", and the body adds «с должной внимательностью»). The comprehensibility reviewer's alternative それぞれ title «каждому своё» was not adopted (an idiom, "to each his own", with a different meaning), and the reviewer withdrew it at recheck. Weak guards suggested as optional by the consistency reviewer were not added: なにも–全然 and 全く, ずっと–ずいぶん, しきりに–よく and しまった–失敗; the titles separate them and the cards teach the contrasts. Several comprehensibility observations needed no action, because the reviewer found them already qualified (そのまま «сразу», たまたま «Так вышло», ところで «даже если», そこで «в связи с этим», しきりに «настойчиво», the атэдзи notes on すてき and とにかく, the verb classes on しゃべる and できれば, and the held-link wording on きちんと, ところが and 実は). Whether to gloss «канго» corpus-wide is an owner-level convention question: 28 published files at the baseline use it, some bare and some with a passing gloss. No reviewer finding remains open.
